entry.title: CFTC Wins Court Order Requiring Two Defendants to Pay Over $31 Million in Digital Asset and Precious Metals Fraud
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and Arkansas Woman to Pay Over $31 Million for Digital Assets, Precious Metals Fraud CFTC · Sep 30, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Fundsz board members and social media moderators, they made material misrepresentations and omissions concerning Fundsz’s expected profits」 The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Middle District of Florida entered a default judgment against Brian Early and Alisha Ann Kingrey for their roles in a digital asset and precious metals fraud involving Fundsz. The court ordered $15,732,455 in restitution and a $15,752,455 civil penalty, permanently enjoined further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations, and imposed permanent registration and trading bans. Separately, consent orders against Rene Larralde's estate representative and Juan Pablo Valcarce required over $2.7 million in assets to be turned over to a court-appointed receiver.

entry.title: CFTC Wins Court Orders Totaling Over $288 Million Against Former Long Island Resident and Firm in Commodity Pool Ponzi Case
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「offered easy access to cryptocurrency and Forex trading using the latest technology available」 The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York entered orders against Eddy Alexandre and his company EminiFX Inc., requiring $228,576,962 in restitution, $15,049,500 in disgorgement, and a $45,148,500 civil monetary penalty. The court found EminiFX was a Ponzi scheme that induced investors with misrepresentations about cryptocurrency and Forex trading. Alexandre is also serving a nine-year prison sentence in a parallel criminal case.

entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining, the region's first such guidance from an international financial centre
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Added Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「providing clear governance and commercial licensing direction for crypto mining operators as well as businesses conducting crypto mining activities within or from ADGM」 The ADGM Registration Authority has published guidance on crypto mining activities in and from ADGM, issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025. The guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. It takes a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms. This is the first phase, with a regulatory framework to be developed and consulted on later.

entry.title: FCA opens crypto firm authorisation applications under new UK regime
entry.summary: FCA opens the gateway to regulated crypto FCA · Sep 30, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「From today, crypto firms can apply for authorisation from the FCA, marking a landmark moment as the UK takes a step closer towards becoming one of the most trusted places in the world to build and inv」 The FCA announced that crypto firms can now apply for authorisation under the UK's new regime. Firms operating in the UK will be brought into full regulation, assessed against standards on consumer protection, safeguarding of customer assets, market integrity and financial resilience. Applications should be submitted by 28 February 2027, ahead of the regime's entry into force on 25 October 2027. Authorisation is not automatic, and firms that cannot meet the standards will not be permitted to operate in the UK market.

entry.title: UK regulator secures repayment for victims of crypto fraud
entry.summary: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud FCA · Sep 28, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「persuading them to invest in fake cryptoasset opportunities through companies including CCX Capital and Astaria Group LLP」 The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga, who ran a fake cryptoasset investment scheme that defrauded at least 65 investors of £1,541,799. The court ordered Bedi to pay £603,404.28 and Mavanga to pay £247,997.99. Recovered funds will be returned to victims.

entry.summary: Implementing the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act for the Issuance of Stablecoins by Entities Subject to the Jurisdiction of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Federal Register · Oct 23, 2026 · Rule · Crypto · Effective Jan 18, 2027Topic evidence: 「Stablecoins are digital assets, i.e., digital representations of value recorded on a cryptographically secured distributed ledger」 The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issues a final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuance and related activities by entities under its jurisdiction, effective January 18, 2027. The document responds to about 328 public comments on the March 2026 proposal, covering reserve asset management, redemption, capital requirements and the yield prohibition. It also explains that BSA/AML requirements will be addressed in a separate rulemaking. The archived text and attachments run to about 150,007 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original.

entry.title: HKSAR Government's fourth digital green bond offering
entry.summary: HKSAR Government’s Fourth Digital Green Bonds Offering HKMA · Sep 29, 2026 · Report · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The Digital Green Bonds are cleared and settled through the CMU」 The HKSAR Government priced about HK$20 billion of digital green bonds in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR under its Government Sustainable Bond Programme. The offering was oversubscribed, with subscription ratios of 1.3 to 11.3 times across the four currencies. The HKD tranche settled using tokenised deposits, which the release describes as a world first for a digital bond.
